text:
Ravi: Quick sync  planning a minimal base-image rebuild tonight 23:30 PT. Need RBAC tweak for the new signer, ensure audit forwarding, and a vuln quick-check. Who can pick tasks?
Nora: I can do RBAC change + MR. Thinking we scope binding to the key resource with a binding condition.
Eli: I'll run the rebuild and vuln scan. If scanner flags new issues, will report here.
Ravi: Audit: include cosign annotations: build_id and commit. Also forward KMS audit entries to splunk:security-images.
OnCallBot: Preflight scan queued for base-image:2026-03-25-nightly -> awaiting results.
Nora: For RBAC: use roles/redwood.kmsSigner with permission cloudkms.cryptoKeySign, binding condition `resource.name.startsWith("projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/")`. MR inbound.
Eli: Scan results: 1 medium (openssl backport) and 0 high. I can patch openssl and rebuild.
Ravi: Good. Timeline: 22:30 build & scan, 23:00 create key version v5, 23:05 sign test image, 23:30 canary to dedicated-canary.
Nora: MR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/525  includes annotation policy and minimal scope. Ping @eng-security for review.
Eli: Rebuild done, patched openssl, re-scan PASS. cosign command used: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKey/versions/5 gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-25-nightly` signature: sha256:feedface
OnCallBot: Canary started 23:30 PT -> 12 pods in canary. Monitoring link: https://grafana.redwood/d/kanary/525
Ravi: Keep watch for >3 pull failures in 10m. If spike, pause rollout and page eng-sre.
Nora: I'll not revoke old versions for 48h. Add rollback: revert promotion to previous signed digest if auth errors.
Eli: Canary 15m check: healthy. Proceeding staged rollout.
OnCallBot: Maintenance-complete recorded by Ravi at 00:45 PT. Audit logs forwarded to splunk:index=security-images.
Ravi: Thanks team, filing compliance note and closing this loop. :thumbsup:
